# DNS Change Monitoring

> Practical DNS change monitoring resources, reviewed by Mira John.

- [DNS Change Monitoring & DNS Change Alerts](https://dns-change-monitoring.github.io/): DNS change monitoring for developers: compare records, monitor DNS changes at authoritative servers and get useful DNS change alerts with DNS Notify.
- [How to Monitor DNS Changes: Developer Runbook](https://dns-change-monitoring.github.io/how-to-monitor-dns-changes/): Learn how to monitor DNS changes: inventory records, query authoritative nameservers, preserve lookup status and review a baseline before scheduling checks.
- [DNS Change Alerts: Examples & Incident Runbook](https://dns-change-monitoring.github.io/dns-change-alerts/): Design useful DNS change alerts with before-and-after records, source evidence and clear response steps. See alert examples and DNS Notify’s email behaviour.
- [Compare DNS Records: Free Local Comparison Tool](https://dns-change-monitoring.github.io/compare-dns-records/): Compare DNS record values in your browser. Detect additions and removals, ignore answer order and duplicates, and test realistic DNS monitoring examples.
- [DNS Monitoring False Positives: Comparison Rules](https://dns-change-monitoring.github.io/dns-monitoring-false-positives/): Reduce DNS change monitoring false positives from record order, TTLs, TXT formatting, CNAME chains and lookup errors. Use a practical comparison checklist.

## Publication

- [Mira John](https://dns-change-monitoring.github.io/authors/mira-john/)
- [RSS updates](https://dns-change-monitoring.github.io/feed.xml)
- [Atom updates](https://dns-change-monitoring.github.io/atom.xml)

## Continuous monitoring

- [DNS Notify DNS change monitoring](https://dnsnotify.com/dns-change-monitoring/): Monitored public record changes and email alerts with previous and new values.
